purpose: Portable deterministic differential regression fixtures; never shipped in docs or used as user data

baseline.basis: Exact Git blob frozen as a test oracle; do not modernize alongside candidate implementation

pgn.basis: 15 owned public-position synthetic games: five legal standard opening lines across bullet/blitz/rapid; fixture-player vs public-position-opponent; not named human games

analysis.basis: Exact 90 records from normal real SF18 baseline full-cohort browser primer, Root-approved seed; no invented scores or PVs
analysis.no_private_content: Only FEN/move cache keys, engine numeric scores/depth/PVs and actual record timestamps; no credentials, URLs, accounts, user histories or storage snapshots

line_endings: Exact source bytes preserved across Git checkouts by local .gitattributes * -text
scope: Unit functional oracle; cached payload replay does not claim an engine benchmark or live/public behavior
